checkpoint.title: The Elite Four and the Champion, then the Hall of Fame

events.why: the precondition for Lorelei: the lead at least Lv51, pokeguy's Blastoise here (docs/battles/pokeguy-conditions.md lorelei; the Route 22 rival takes it from 49 to 51)

the Items pocket read once for the whole League: stops before the door if the bag holds less than the League's minimum (the bag of 2026-11-16, LEAGUE_MINIMUM), else plans each fight's item budget from it (plan_league()) and logs the plan
from the Mart's counter north to below the League's door (4, 1), past the door guard (5, 3), who only talks when spoken to
onto the door (4, 1), the warp into Lorelei's room at its south entrance (6, 12)
the room's OnFrame script (PokemonLeague_EventScript_EnterRoom) walks the player five tiles north from (6, 12) to (6, 7) and closes the entrance behind; no text
to (6, 6) facing Lorelei (6, 5), planned from where the room's walk left the player: a tile north, or a step round if the walk ended a tile off
Lorelei (6, 5): her intro, then the battle (trainerbattle_no_intro)

Lorelei (TRAINER_ELITE_FOUR_LORELEI): Dewgong Lv52, Cloyster Lv51, Slowbro Lv52, Jynx Lv54, Lapras Lv54, two Full Restores; fought by budgeted C2 (budgeted-setup, the League plan's per-fight item budget; before that goal-based-setup: Sp. Atk +4 by X Specials, X Speed until faster, Guard Spec first against an accuracy drop; the doc's lorelei row, 94.3% at 159/159); foe_threats are the rows PokemonSimulation's player-strategy planning_risk() gives for each foe leading against console B's Lv54 Blastoise (171 HP, Def 135, Sp. Def 150) at full HP: the 80th percentile of the foe's move choice, its mean, its worst case and its worst normal hit. Lapras's worst case is 62. Cloyster's only hit, Dive, hides a turn first (its row's ninth column): no KO risk until it is underwater. Dewgong's worst normal hit is 30, not the generator's 18: console B, 2026-11-16, took 30 of 162 in one turn. foe_stats are each foe's Defense, Sp. Def and HP from the doc's table, for the damage each attack would do and whether the best one KOs (no X item then). Then her door north (6, 2) opens
the precondition for Bruno: the lead at least Lv52, pokeguy's Blastoise here (docs/battles/pokeguy-conditions.md bruno; Lorelei's fight takes it a level up)

the League plan's rules between fights (PokemonFRLG_AutoStoryLeaguePlan.h, between_fight_item()): a status cured, Super Potions up to Bruno's entry HP, a Full Restore only when they run out, an Elixir or Max Elixir when Surf or Blizzard is under its PP floor. Replaces the per-checkpoint heal_to_full, whose HP was unknown after a load (Bruno entered at 71%, console B, 2026-11-16)

Bruno (TRAINER_ELITE_FOUR_BRUNO): Onix Lv51, Hitmonchan Lv53, Hitmonlee Lv53, Onix Lv54, Machamp Lv56, two Full Restores; fought by budgeted C2 (budgeted-setup, the League plan's per-fight item budget; before that goal-based-setup: Sp. Atk +2 by X Specials, X Speed until faster, Guard Spec first against an accuracy drop; the doc's bruno row, 95.9% at 130/162. The doc's target_torrent (stalling to Torrent in the opening) is the C++ policy's extra X Specials against the first Onix, up to +4 while Torrent is off; its weaker-move stall needs the foe's HP and is not modelled (PokemonFRLG_AutoStoryBattlePolicy.h)); foe_threats are the rows PokemonSimulation's player-strategy planning_risk() gives for each foe leading against console B's Lv54 Blastoise (171 HP, Def 135, Sp. Def 150) at full HP: Machamp's worst case (crit Cross Chop) is 150, Hitmonlee's 114. The first Onix has Roar (marked as phazing in its row): console B, 2026-11-16, its Roar sent Blastoise out after four X Specials. foe_stats are each foe's Defense, Sp. Def and HP from the doc's table: Surf KOs both Onix at +0, so no X item is spent on them and setup waits for Hitmonchan. Then the door north (6, 2) opens

the Champion (TRAINER_CHAMPION_FIRST_BULBASAUR for a player who took Squirtle): Pidgeot Lv59, Alakazam Lv57, Rhydon Lv59, Gyarados Lv59, Arcanine Lv61, Venusaur Lv63, four Full Restores; fought by budgeted C2 (budgeted-setup, the League plan's per-fight item budget; before that goal-based-setup: Sp. Atk +2 and Accuracy +2 by X Specials and X Accuracies, X Speed until faster, Guard Spec first against Pidgeot's Sand Attack; the doc's champion row, 95.6% at 171/171, its opening a Guard Spec); foe_threats are the rows PokemonSimulation's player-strategy planning_risk() gives for each foe leading against console B's Lv54 Blastoise (171 HP, Def 135, Sp. Def 150) at full HP, Pidgeot's row marked as lowering accuracy: Venusaur's Solar Beam worst normal hit is 198 (a one-hit KO from full), Rhydon's worst case 183; Solar Beam without sun charges a turn first (Venusaur's row's ninth column), so it is a KO risk only while Venusaur is charging or the sun is out (the battle text), else setup goes on; Pidgeot (Whirlwind) and Arcanine (Roar) are marked as phazing, so no X item is spent on them (their stages would go with a forced switch). foe_stats are each foe's Defense, Sp. Def and HP from the doc's table: Surf KOs Rhydon, so it is attacked at once

the rival's last words, Oak's entrance and his talk, and Oak leading the player out north (PokemonLeague_ChampionsRoom_Movement_PlayerExit) to the Hall of Fame (5, 12); its OnFrame script walks the player eight tiles north to (5, 4), Oak's congratulations, then the record (FLDEFF_HALL_OF_FAME_RECORD) and the Hall of Fame (special EnterHallOfFame), which saves the game itself and rolls the credits

checkpoint: Starts at Indigo Plateau's Mart counter, where 20.01a ends. The whole League is one checkpoint, with no save between the fights until the Hall of Fame (user, 2026-11-16; overrides a boss battle per checkpoint): league_start reads the bag once and plans every fight's items from it (PokemonFRLG_AutoStoryLeaguePlan.h), and each battle spends its budget plus what the fights before left. A failed fight goes back to this row's start.
The League rooms are one-way: the entrance closes behind the player, and the next room's door opens only when the room's trainer is beaten.
PokeGuy's fights: Lorelei 1:46:37, Bruno 1:49:15, Agatha 1:51:12, Lance 1:53:07, the Champion 1:55:44 (docs/battles/pokeguy-conditions.md); his turns: ~/BDSPLab/notes/pokeguy-league-turns.md.
Ends in the Hall of Fame (5, 4) facing north. The Hall of Fame saves the game itself (respawn at Pallet Town) and the credits follow: the row's own save at its end is not one the game offers there.
